Residues 690-788 returned 0 PDB100 hits in 3Di-AA mode and a single TM-align hit at TM 0.26. No lipid-binding module detected. No basic membrane-facing surface (Fisher OR 0.37, p = 0.228).
Same as GO:0008289. No phosphoinositide-binding fold and no reported PI4P or PI(4,5)P2 binding assay.

An ARM/HEAT solenoid is architecturally compatible with an adaptor, but the concave groove is partly self-occluded: removing 690-788 exposes 72 buried core residues across 8 helical segments at mean pLDDT 93.6, and 42 percent of C-terminal residues lie inside the 32.9 A solenoid radius. No stable partner is documented.
curator_verification_required: yes, revisit if a direct binary interaction with a trafficking component is published
